evals.prompt: Add an email validator with strict TDD: write a failing test first, minimal implementation, then refactor.
evals.expected_behavior: Announces TDD discipline, writes one failing test and confirms it fails for the right reason before any production code, then applies minimal green code and refactors only after green.
assertions: Does not write production code before a failing test exists
Confirms the test fails for the expected reason (feature missing, not syntax/import noise)
Writes only enough production code to pass the current test

evals.prompt: parseAmount('£1,000.00') returns the wrong value. Fix it with a failing test first.
evals.expected_behavior: Reproduces the bug with a failing test, watches it fail, then applies the minimal fix and keeps the suite green.
assertions: Writes a test that encodes the expected amount before changing production code
Uses the red-green-refactor cycle rather than fix-then-test
Verifies the suite after the fix

evals.prompt: Add edge-case handling to the existing email validator for three new invalid-input cases.
evals.expected_behavior: Adds one failing test for one edge case, watches it fail, writes the minimal code to pass it, then moves to the next case — never writing all three tests or all the handling logic upfront.
assertions: Writes and confirms one failing test at a time rather than all edge-case tests upfront
Writes only the minimal code needed for the current test before moving to the next case
Does not batch all production-code handling before the corresponding tests exist

evals.prompt: I already wrote a fix for parseAmount before writing any tests. Now let's add TDD coverage for it.
evals.expected_behavior: Applies the Delete Rule: deletes the unverified production code rather than adapting it, then rewrites the behavior test-first through the red-green-refactor cycle.
assertions: Deletes the pre-existing unverified implementation rather than retrofitting tests around it
Writes a new failing test first and confirms it fails for the right reason
Rewrites the implementation test-first rather than reusing the original code path

evals.prompt: Rerun the parser tests before claiming the bug is fixed.
evals.expected_behavior: Does not treat this as a TDD authoring task; routes to verification-before-completion or a simple re-run of existing tests rather than starting a new red-green-refactor cycle.
assertions: Does not start a red-green-refactor implementation cycle
Recognizes the ask is completion verification, not test-first design
Names verification-before-completion (or an equivalent fresh test re-run) as the correct path

evals.prompt: Update the README's environment variable table to document the new REDIS_URL setting. No code changes.
evals.expected_behavior: Recognizes this is documentation-only with no executable logic and does not force a red-green-refactor cycle or ask for a failing test.
assertions: Does not require a failing test before editing documentation
Does not invoke the RED-GREEN-REFACTOR workflow for a docs-only change
